description: Recaps a coding session: intent, key decisions, what changed, open threads, where to resume. With no session given, the newest session of the calling agent in `cwd`. Returns a stored recap when the session has not changed since. Otherwise, if session-recap has a model configured it writes the recap; if not, it returns the condensed transcript and instructions, and you write the recap yourself and store it with save_recap.

agent.description: The agent whose sessions to look in; default: the caller

cwd.description: The project folder you are working in (absolute path)

format.description: "recap" (default: intent, decisions, changes, open threads, resume), "standup", "handoff" or "pr"

mode.description: "agent": you write it; "model": session-recap writes it; "auto" (default): model if configured

refresh.description: Write it again even if a stored recap is current

session.description: A session id or words in its title; empty for the current session

name: recap_session
title: Recap a session
